what: The declared FLOOR for Bun FRONT overlays. Human pin. Same posture as runtimes/rails-base/FLOOR.json.
why: ADR 0072: FRONT is a Bun container with its own image. Overlays FROM that digest.
A mutable :latest is not a pin. check_base_digests already refuses undigested FROM lines.
Do not auto-bump. publish-images rebuilding front-base does not move this file.

floor.note: PUBLISHED AND MULTI-ARCH, which the previous note said was not yet possible. That note ended 'Last public GHCR index does not exist until publish-images ships front-base' and 'FROM front-base@sha256:<id> does NOT resolve for a local never-pushed image -- verified, exit 1 -- so overlays must use the tag front-base:local'. Both were true of a local build and are false of this one: publish-images shipped front-base at 31db447 for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, so a digest FROM resolves and the tag form is no longer forced. The previous local arm64 build sha256:01992b23f643 remains a different identity and is still what bin/build-baselines produces for local work.
floor.verified_at: 2026-09-21: docker buildx imagetools inspect reports mediaType application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json with Platform linux/amd64 AND linux/arm64. Contents were READ OUT OF THE RUNNING IMAGE on each platform rather than assumed, and are identical on both: bun 1.4.2, 22 widget modules under src/widgets, 4 front_bind_refused sites and 12 actorCid references in src/skeleton.js -- i.e. this floor carries the bind that fails closed and the actor the bind produces, not a pre-G13 skeleton.

bun_base.note: Multi-arch index digest for the Bun runtime the FRONT Dockerfile FROMs. Not the front-base FLOOR.

moving_the_floor: Edit this file. That is the whole mechanism.
Every consumer's gate compares its FRONT pin to this file and fails on a mismatch.
Bump the consumers promptly, or revert here.
